Devon: Quick postmortem follow-up: need owners/timelines for the cert/SNI fanout issue and retry spike. Posting actions below, pls ack and add links.
Katie: Summary: mid-rollout some edge nodes returned probe success with new SNI mapping; sticky route lookup used stale hints -> 421s and client retry shift across regions.
Ben: Narrow cause: healthchecks read mixed SNI mapping state during staggered rotation. Confirming sticky lookup mismatch.
Maria: I'll track items in PM tracker and flag CS comms.
Devon: Actions:
- AI-1: Make healthcheck read SNI mapping atomically (Ben)  ETA: Wed EOD
- AI-2: Canary gate for SNI rotation to avoid partial mapping (Katie)  ETA: Fri 09:00 PT
- AI-3: Short-term autoscale guard to limit cross-region fanout (Maria)  ETA: next sprint
- AI-4: Telemetry per-node SNI version + probe mismatch metric (Ben)  ETA: Thu noon
- AI-5: Chaos test simulating partial rotation in staging (OpsOncall)  ETA: Mon next week
Ben: Ack AI-1/AI-4. Opening PRs now.
Katie: Ack AI-2, will propose region-configurable gating flow today.
Maria: Will propose mitigation circuit by Fri.
OpsOncall: Scheduling chaos run; adding rollback steps to runbook.
SRE-bot: Uploaded incident summary: https://redwood.internal/reports/incident-1719504321
Devon: Ben add a quick deploy compatibility test to check mapping consistency across pool, e.g.:
for host in $(cat pool.txt); do curl -s https://$host/health | jq .sni_version; done | sort | uniq -c
Ben: Will add pipeline check and threshold fail. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/2389
Katie: Adding alert sni.mapping.mismatch.rate P1 during rollout window. OpsOncall?
OpsOncall: Added alert, threshold >0.5% mismatch over 5m triggers P1. Runbook attached.
Maria: Draft CS note ready, will circulate.
Devon: Please drop PR/issue links here as created. Sync tomorrow 10:30 PT. Closing thread for active assignment.
SRE-bot: Reminder set for follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30 PT.
